You must hire a pixel artist to create the item sprite and icon. We will not supply them. Your sprite and icon must meet the standards of the rest of FO2's art. The pixel artist must sign an Artist Assignment Agreement transferring ownership to Pixel Games LLC. Once every step is complete, we'll add the item to the game and send you the only copy that will ever exist. You may also choose to add your character's name to the item's tooltip.
